findings.title: Bind the new typed reaction authority to its exact source request
findings.finding: The new loader branch validates entity_type, source kind, frame-token label and contextual scope, but it never checks whether the typed source URL requests that exact MetaCyc frame at the accepted issuing endpoint, or whether version has the supported native format. The generic source check only requires an HTTP(S) netloc and nonempty strings. Consequently an internally contradictory typed authority is accepted by the blocking identifier gate.
findings.reproduction: Starting from the sealed complete unchanged ribose draft and composed authority, change only the native reaction source URL to https://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr/getxml?id=META:RXN-OTHER, or to the ECOLI:RXN-14904 request, or to https://example.invalid/native.xml. Each still yields identifier_errors=[] for MetaCyc:RXN-14904. Changing only version to "not a PGDB version" also passes. Missing type and missing kind controls both reject.
findings.impact: The newly introduced closed typed provenance contract admits source records that contradict the identity they purport to establish. This is a static internal-consistency defect, not evidence that the authentic native original or builder output is wrong.
findings.remedy: For sources with kind=metacyc-reaction-xml only, validate the exact supported HTTPS getxml request grammar and META scope, validate the supported numeric dotted version grammar, and require each referencing typed reaction CURIE to equal the requested frame. Retain the current kind/type/label/synonym checks. Add focused loader/gate regressions for wrong host, endpoint, frame, organism, malformed/duplicate/query or fragment forms, invalid versions, and one source incorrectly reused for another typed identity. Keep all legacy untyped authorities unchanged.
findings.limits: Do not hard-code RXN-14904. Do not claim the loader can authenticate source-body bytes or attest that a syntactically valid version equals unavailable XML; original-body digest/request/PGDB agreement remains the builder and acquisition-receipt responsibility.

advisories.title: Optionally reject unexpected mixed content in element-only native containers
advisories.finding: Mutating the authentic original to add non-whitespace metadata/Reaction text or Compound/parent Reaction tails is accepted and produces the same identity. Existing shape checks inspect child count, attributes and child text but omit those tail/container text locations.
advisories.evidence: probes.json xml_mixed_content_probes and four retained mutated XML originals; terminal f60929/0
advisories.remedy: Optional: reject non-whitespace text/tails only in containers whose supported native serialization is element-only. Preserve genuine numeric/prose slots with nested evidence; do not add a blanket recursive ban that would reject the authentic gibbs-0 evidence structure.
advisories.limits: No wrong identity, altered chemical assertion, entity expansion or canonical-name promotion was demonstrated. This is optional parser hardening, not a separate adoption blocker.
